instruction:
Build a hammer with ShadowBox from the three opened reference meshes. Open ZBrush 2025 from the desktop shortcut and continue from the supplied scene or mesh. SilhouetteFront lies in XY, SilhouetteSide in YZ, and SilhouetteTop in XZ at the stated head height. Isolate and frame each flat silhouette in its matching orthographic view, convert its visible mesh outline into a mask/alpha, and align those masks on the corresponding front, side, and top ShadowBox walls. Generate the enclosed hammer, clean it with DynaMesh as needed, rename it Hammer, and export only that result as `C:\Users\user\Desktop\output.obj`.

The output must be one manifold object/group named Hammer, have an approximately 0.5 x 2.0 x 0.3 BU bounding box with 20% tolerance per axis, achieve at least 0.5 front-view silhouette IoU with SilhouetteFront, and contain at most six face groups.

command:
import ctypes, time
user32 = ctypes.windll.user32
EnumWindowsProc = ctypes.WINFUNCTYPE(ctypes.c_bool, ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_void_p)
EnumChildProc = ctypes.WINFUNCTYPE(ctypes.c_bool, ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_void_p)
def close_error():
    wins = []
    def wcb(hwnd, lparam):
        buf = ctypes.create_unicode_buffer(512)
        user32.GetWindowTextW(hwnd, buf, 512)
        if 'ZHomePage.exe' in buf.value and 'System Error' in buf.value:
            wins.append(hwnd)
        return True
    user32.EnumWindows(EnumWindowsProc(wcb), 0)
    for hwnd in wins:
        buttons = []
        def ccb(ch, lparam):
            text = ctypes.create_unicode_buffer(128)
            cls = ctypes.create_unicode_buffer(128)
            user32.GetWindowTextW(ch, text, 128)
            user32.GetClassNameW(ch, cls, 128)
            if text.value == 'OK' or cls.value == 'Button':
                buttons.append(ch)
            return True
        user32.EnumChildWindows(hwnd, EnumChildProc(ccb), 0)
        for ch in buttons:
            user32.SendMessageW(ch, 0x00F5, 0, 0)
time.sleep(95)
for _ in range(4):
    close_error()
    time.sleep(2)
